_comment: Copy to profile/search.json. What the scheduled search looks for. Indeed: each query runs in every tier (most specific first); a job is tagged with the first tier that finds it. `domain` picks a country site (ca.indeed.com, uk.indeed.com, ...). Indeed queries accept AND / OR / quotes. LinkedIn: each query runs in each location. fromageDays = only jobs posted in the last N days. maxPerRun caps new jobs per run.
